name: West Virginia
overview: West Virginia sells tax liens on real estate whose property taxes stay delinquent. By September 10 each year the county sheriff prepares a list of delinquent lands, and the tax liens on them are certified to the State Auditor on October 31. The Auditor then sells each certified tract's tax lien at public auction at the county courthouse, within 90 days after certification, to the highest bidder for at least the taxes, interest and charges due. Under W. Va. Code §11A-3-56 the owner may redeem at any time before a tax deed is issued, paying interest at one percent per month from the date of sale; an unredeemed purchaser can then pursue a tax deed.

counties.office: West Virginia State Auditor's Office, County Collections Division
counties.address: 1900 Kanawha Blvd. East, Building 1, Room W-100, Charleston, WV 25305; sales are held at the Kanawha County courthouse under W. Va. Code §11A-3-45
counties.next_sale_note: No sale posted. The State Auditor's County Collections page says: "There are no land sale listings currently available." By statute, liens are certified to the Auditor on October 31 and sold within 90 days after certification, but no Kanawha County date has been published.
counties.how_to_bid: Bidders pre-register with the State Auditor's County Collections Division; pre-registration covers all counties for one year, and multiple companies must register individually. Each tract or lot is sold to the highest bidder at public auction at the county courthouse. Payment is by check or money order payable to the sheriff of the county, delivered before the close of business on the day of the sale. Deposit not stated.

notes.conflict_note: The Kanawha County Sheriff's collection-enforcement page (https://www.kanawhasheriff.us/tax-2/collection-enforcement/) still says 'Every year, in November, the Sheriff conducts the annual ritual of auctioning any delinquent real estate tax liens.' Its newest sale list found was dated Nov. 15, 2021. Current W. Va. Code §11A-3-2 has the liens certified to the Auditor instead, so that page is treated as outdated and not used as a schedule.
